cases.unexpectedTitle: Unexpected findings per repeat, with the skill minus without it

outcomeTitle.caught: Passes only with the skill: the skill caught it.
outcomeTitle.regressed: Passes only without the skill: the skill made it worse.
outcomeTitle.pass_both: Passes with and without the skill.
outcomeTitle.fail_both: Fails with and without the skill.
outcomeTitle.flaky: Repeats disagree within one arm; excluded from caught and regressed.
